create_dtensor_from_local: create a DTensor from a local torch.Tensor using from_local with device mesh and placements
distribute_tensor_shard: distribute a torch.Tensor across a device mesh with sharding placements
redistribute_dtensor_placements: redistribute a DTensor from current placements to new placements with collectives
full_tensor_gather: gather and concatenate local DTensor shards from all ranks into a full tensor
distribute_module_params: convert module parameters and buffers to DTensors using distribute_module
